summary: The school district emphasizes the importance of E-Rate for connectivity and modern education, urging the FCC to preserve and strengthen the program rather than sunset or reduce it.

claims.argument: E-Rate is essential infrastructure for modern public education
claims.evidence_quote: With the impact of artificial intelligence (AI), connectivity is essential. Noxon School District 10 A.K.A. Noxon Public Schools has received $76,703 in committed federal E-Rate support over funding years 2021–2025 — an average of roughly $15,341 a year toward the connections our students depend on.
